patterns.message: Import NAMED keys from content JSON, never the default. Vite tree-shakes named JSON keys per top-level key but keeps the whole object for a default import — measured on this repo: `import { US_STATE_NAMES } from states.json` is 0.51 kB gzip, `import states from states.json` is 28.28 kB. A default import silently drags every bank it touches into the chunk. NOTE: t.en.json / t.es.json are deliberately NOT in this list — a language bank is consumed whole (all 463 keys), so there is nothing for per-key shaking to remove, and `Bank = typeof en` from the default import is what gives compile-time-checked keys.
